html:
G'oya

"Barcha buyurtmalari katta" degani "kichik buyurtmasi yo'q". Buni NOT EXISTS bilan tekshiramiz. Lekin buyurtmasi umuman yo'q mijozda ham kichik buyurtma yo'q, shuning uchun alohida EXISTS bilan kamida bitta buyurtma borligini talab qilamiz.

Yechim

SELECT id, name
FROM customers c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM orders o
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.amount < 100000
  )

Kichik buyurtma < 100000 deb yozildi, chunki aynan 100 000 so'mlik buyurtma katta hisoblanadi.

Tuzoqlar

Faqat NOT EXISTS qoldirilsa, namunada xato ko'rinmaydi, chunki u yerda hamma mijozning buyurtmasi bor. Buyurtmasiz mijoz paydo bo'lishi bilan u ham natijaga chiqadi: "kichik buyurtmasi yo'q" shart unga ham to'g'ri keladi.

Noto'g'riSELECT id, name
FROM customers c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM orders o
  WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.amount < 100000
)

Ikkinchi xato savolni "kamida bitta katta buyurtmasi bor" deb o'qish. Namunadagi Dilnozaning 400 000 lik buyurtmasi bor, lekin 90 000 liki ham bor, u chiqmasligi kerak.

Boshqa yo'l

Mijozning eng kichik buyurtmasi 100 000 dan kam bo'lmasa, qolganlari ham kam emas. Buyurtmasiz mijozlar esa GROUP BY natijasiga umuman tushmaydi:

SELECT id, name
FROM customers
WHERE id IN (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING MIN(amount) >= 100000
)
